scripts.dev: npm run build:contracts && concurrently "npm run dev -w apps/api" "npm run dev -w apps/web"
scripts.dev:api: npm run build:contracts && npm run dev -w apps/api
scripts.dev:web: npm run build:contracts && npm run dev -w apps/web
scripts.build: npm run build -w packages/contracts && npm run db:generate && npm run build -w apps/api && npm run build -w apps/web
scripts.test: npm run build:contracts && npm run test -w apps/api
scripts.lint: npm run build -w packages/contracts && npm run lint -w apps/api && npm run lint -w apps/web
